name: Nanyang
registryBasis: The Nanyang Real Estate Registration Service Center and the Nanyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau publish city-local real-estate registration services. The official guidance limits record queries to rights holders or interested parties and requires a stated reason and identity documents; no anonymous parcel geometry service was verified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Reviewed official city registration pages did not expose an anonymous full-parcel geometry endpoint. The documented record-query path is restricted to rights holders/interested parties and identity documentation.
scopeLimits: City-local official registry and service guidance inspected. No sign-in, identity workflow, owner/address/tax field, or property-specific lookup was used. The web page fetch tool returned 403 for both official city registry pages, so their public content was assessed from search results; no status is claimed for a direct browser GET.
remainingUncertainty: A separate public planning map may exist, but no city-specific anonymous parcel feature schema or geometry route was verified.
